rules: Every mutating ExecutionRequest must declare target_authority.
ActionCoordinator must be bound to the selected authority_context.
A mutation is admitted only when authority_context == target_authority before approval and executor dispatch.
DOMAIN:X -> UAOS direct mutation is prohibited.
DOMAIN:X -> DOMAIN:Y direct mutation is prohibited.
UAOS -> DOMAIN:X direct business mutation is prohibited; dispatch/handoff into the domain owner instead.
Cross-scope change requests are proposals/handoffs, not direct authoritative writes.

full_host_level_enforcement_requires: repository-scoped credentials or tool mediation by authority context
and/or repository rulesets/branch protections restricting the raw writer identity
